mainImage.alt: The U.S. Capitol building dome rising against a blue sky in Washington D.C., the seat of Congress where the Section 702 surveillance law extension was debated and voted on
mainImage.caption: The U.S. Capitol building in Washington D.C. on March 26, 2026. Congress voted on April 17, 2026 to extend Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act for 10 days until April 30, as civil libertarians and surveillance-state supporters continue to battle over the warrantless surveillance program.
